comments.note: src/VideoIndexer.Core/Filtering/FilterExpressionEvaluator.cs: Dispatch table refactor is clean and well-structured. static readonly dictionaries are allocated once at class initialisation with no per-call heap cost. All lambda captures are marked static (no closure allocations). StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase on dictionary lookup and StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase in EvaluateStringContains are consistent. Error paths correctly throw FilterExpressionException(FilterExpressionPhase.Evaluate, ...) per project constraints. Implicit int→decimal widening in the numeric dispatch table lambdas is correct (no explicit cast needed, and avoids double/float promotion). The heterogeneous handling of boolean functions (ignore node arg) vs. string-predicate functions (pass node for arg validation) is clean — EvaluateStringContains correctly validates the argument count and type in one place.
